name: Snapshot
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Save or copy the current frame, capture bursts, export clips
description:
Saves, saves as or copies the current frame (the source frame, or the rendered frame with video effects and subtitles) as PNG, JPEG or BMP; captures a burst of frames; exports part of a video as MP4. One sidebar tab, Snapshots & Clips, holds the controls, the running exports and the finished results.
Right-click menu: Video ▸ Snapshot; Alt+S opens the tab.
